# J2J Connection

> J2J Connection (legal name J2J Connection LLC) is an AI consultancy based in Santa Monica, California, run by Hayden Jardine and Tom Jardine. J2J sets up AI for owners of architecture, design, construction, and real estate firms who want their teams using AI and do not have the time to implement it themselves: ChatGPT Business or Claude workspaces, connected tools, access levels by role, plain-language guardrails, and training for every seat, done for you. Engagements are fixed scope and fixed price, agreed before work starts. The first 30-minute call is free.

## Services

- [ChatGPT and Claude setup](https://j2j.info/services/chatgpt-claude-setup/): Business workspace setup for built environment firms, with email, calendar and files connected, access levels set by role, plain-language guardrails, and training for the whole team.
- [AI consulting for the built environment](https://j2j.info/): Practical AI systems for construction and real estate teams, built around project work.
- [J2J Time](https://j2j.info/j2j-time/): An AI time tracker that drafts billable time entries from calendar and email activity for human review.

## Work

- [Billable-time case study](https://j2j.info/case-studies/billable-time/): Nightly AI time reports for LC Three, an owner’s-representation firm for construction projects.

## Guides

- [Automatic billable-time tracking](https://j2j.info/guides/automatic-billable-time-tracking/): How to turn email, calendar and phone activity into a timesheet you can review.
